title: Mexican Red Rice
description: Restaurant-style Mexican rice toasted in oil, then simmered with blended tomato, onion and garlic until tender and orange-red.
equipment: Medium saucepan or deep skillet with a lid

image.alt: A bowl of red-orange rice with peas and carrots

steps.text: Blend the tomato sauce, onion, garlic and broth until smooth.
Heat the oil in the pan over medium heat. Add the rice and stir until golden and toasty, {time 5-7 min}.
Pour in the tomato mixture (it will sputter), add the salt and cumin and bring to a boil.
Cover, turn the heat to low and simmer without stirring until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender, {time 20 min}. Rest, covered, for {time 5 min}, then fluff and scatter with cilantro.

notes: Use vegetable broth for a vegan rice.
